pairs: There was a certain man from Ramah of Zophim,
the name of one was Hannah,
and the name of the second was Peninnah.
But Hannah did not have children.
Et ascendebat vir ille de civitate sua statutis diebus,
And this man went up from his city,
et sacrificaret Domino exercituum in Silo.
so that he might adore and sacrifice to the Lord of hosts at Shiloh.
Erant autem ibi duo filii Heli,
Now the two sons of Eli,
And he gave portions to his wife Peninnah,
et cunctis filiis ejus et filiabus,
Annæ autem dedit partem unam tristis,
But to Hannah he gave one portion with sorrow.
but the Lord had closed her womb.
And her rival afflicted her and vehemently distressed her,
in tantum ut exprobraret quod Dominus conclusisset vulvam ejus:
for she rebuked her that the Lord had closed her womb.
And she did so every year,
cum redeunte tempore ascenderent ad templum Domini,
when the time returned for them to ascend to the temple of the Lord.
And she provoked her in this way.
she wept and did not take food.
Dixit ergo ei Elcana vir suus:
her husband Elkanah said to her:
et quam ob rem affligitur cor tuum?
And why do you not eat?
numquid non ego melior tibi sum,
And for what reason do you afflict your heart?
Am I not better to you than ten sons?”
Surrexit autem Anna postquam comederat et biberat in Silo.
And so, after she ate and drank at Shiloh, Hannah rose up.
Et Heli sacerdote sedente super sellam ante postes templi Domini,
And Eli, the priest, was sitting on the seat before the door of the temple of the Lord.
And since Hannah was bitter in soul,
si respiciens videris afflictionem famulæ tuæ, et recordatus mei fueris,
in looking with favor, you will see the affliction of your servant and will remember me,
and will not forget your handmaid,
and if you will give to your servant a male child,
dabo eum Domino omnibus diebus vitæ ejus,
then I will give him to the Lord all the days of his life,
et novacula non ascendet super caput ejus.
and no razor shall pass over his head.”
cum illa multiplicaret preces coram Domino,
while she multiplied prayers before the Lord,
Porro Anna loquebatur in corde suo,
For Hannah was speaking in her heart,
and her voice was barely heard.
Therefore, Eli considered her to be drunk,
and so he said to her:
You should take only a little wine,
nam mulier infelix nimis ego sum:
For I am an exceedingly unhappy woman,
sed effudi animam meam in conspectu Domini.
I have poured out my soul in the sight of the Lord.
Ne reputes ancillam tuam quasi unam de filiabus Belial:
You should not repute your handmaid as one of the daughters of Belial.
For I have been speaking from the abundance of my sorrow and grief,
et mœroris mei locuta sum usque in præsens.
et Deus Israël det tibi petitionem tuam quam rogasti eum.
And may the God of Israel grant to you your petition, which you have begged of him.”
Utinam inveniat ancilla tua gratiam in oculis tuis.
“I wish that your handmaid may find grace in your eyes.”
Et abiit mulier in viam suam,
And the woman went on her way,
vultusque illius non sunt amplius in diversa mutati.
and her countenance was no longer changed for the worse.
And they rose up in the morning,
and they worshipped before the Lord.
et venerunt in domum suam Ramatha.
and arrived at their own house at Ramah.
Cognovit autem Elcana Annam uxorem suam:
Then Elkanah knew his wife Hannah.
Et factum est post circulum dierum,
Hannah conceived and bore a son.
And she called his name Samuel,
eo quod a Domino postulasset eum.
because she had requested him from the Lord.
Ascendit autem vir ejus Elcana, et omnis domus ejus,
Now her husband Elkanah ascended with his entire house,
ut immolaret Domino hostiam solemnem, et votum suum.
so that he might immolate to the Lord a solemn sacrifice, with his vow.
But Hannah did not go up.
For she said to her husband,
“I will not go, until the infant has been weaned,
and until I may lead him,
so that he may appear before the sight of the Lord,
Et ait ei Elcana vir suus:
And her husband Elkanah said to her:
and stay until you wean him.
precorque ut impleat Dominus verbum suum.
And I pray that the Lord may fulfill his word.” Therefore,
until she withdrew him from milk.
And after she had weaned him,
and a small bottle of wine,
et adduxit eum ad domum Domini in Silo.
and she led him to the house of the Lord at Shiloh.
But the boy was still a young child.
and they presented the boy to Eli.
quæ steti coram te hic orans Dominum.
who stood before you here, praying to the Lord.
et dedit mihi Dominus petitionem meam quam postulavi eum.
and the Lord granted to me my petition, which I asked of him.
Idcirco et ego commodavi eum Domino cunctis diebus quibus fuerit commodatus Domino.
Because of this, I have also lent him to the Lord, for all the days when he shall be lent to the Lord.”
And they adored the Lord in that place.
